Working dir /dayjs. Apply EXACTLY these two edits to /dayjs/src/plugin/timezone/index.js, then verify. Do not change anything else.

EDIT 1 — in the `proto.tz` function, change the line:
`    const diff = (this.toDate() - new Date(target)) / 1000 / 60`
to:
`    const diff = Math.round((this.toDate() - new Date(target)) / 1000 / 60)`

EDIT 2 — in the `d.tz` function, change:
```
  d.tz = function (input, timezone) {
    const previousOffset = tzOffset(+d(), timezone)
    const localTs = d.utc(input).valueOf()
```
to:
```
  d.tz = function (input, timezone) {
    const previousOffset = tzOffset(+d(), timezone)
    if (typeof input !== 'string') {
      // timestamp, js Date, Day.js object
      return d(input).tz(timezone)
    }
    const localTs = d.utc(input).valueOf()
```

Then create the temp file /dayjs/test/zzz_verify.test.js with EXACTLY:
```js
import dayjs from '../src'
import utc from '../src/plugin/utc'
import timezone from '../src/plugin/timezone'

dayjs.extend(utc)
dayjs.extend(timezone)

const NY = 'America/New_York'

it('verify', () => {
  const newYork = dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY)
  expect(newYork.format()).toBe('2014-06-01T12:00:00-04:00')
  expect(newYork.valueOf()).toBe(1401638400000)
  const ts = newYork.valueOf()
  expect(dayjs.tz(ts, NY).format()).toBe('2014-06-01T12:00:00-04:00')
  expect(dayjs.tz(ts, NY).valueOf()).toBe(ts)
  expect(dayjs.tz(newYork.toDate(), NY).format()).toBe('2014-06-01T12:00:00-04:00')
  expect(dayjs.tz(newYork, NY).format()).toBe('2014-06-01T12:00:00-04:00')
  expect(dayjs.tz(newYork, NY).valueOf()).toBe(ts)
  const laMs = dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00.123Z').tz('America/Los_Angeles')
  expect(laMs.format('Z')).toBe('-07:00')
  expect(laMs.utcOffset()).toBe(-420)
  const la = dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz('America/Los_Angeles')
  expect(la.format()).toBe('2014-06-01T05:00:00-07:00')
  expect(la.format('Z')).toBe('-07:00')
  expect(la.valueOf()).toBe(1401624000000)
  expect(la.utcOffset()).toBe(-420)
  console.log('LA_MS_FORMAT=' + laMs.format() + ' LA_MS_VALUE=' + laMs.valueOf())
})
```
